deciding_clauses: # Check if strong ciphers are set in "--tls-cipher-suites"

native_policy: An explicitly configured nonempty list contained in the existing six reviewed TLS1.2 suites; other TLS settings are separate checks.
difference: Fresh pinned Prowler defaults allow only three TLS1.3 cipher names via audit_config. Existing native/SQL policy uses six configured TLS1.2 suites; TLS1.3 negotiation cannot be proved from this flag, and current source equivalence is explicitly not asserted.
reason: Kubernetes tls-cipher-suites configures the Go CipherSuites list. Go documents that list for TLS1.0-1.2 and does not make TLS1.3 cipher suites configurable through it. Requiring the fresh upstream three TLS1.3 names in this flag would not demonstrate their negotiation. The existing corrected native policy remains useful and is not advertised as executing the defective fresh default.
limits: No TLS handshake, runtime negotiation or controller/OS enforcement proof.
Minimum TLS version is assessed by its separate native criterion.
